name: MACD
summary: This EA trades based on MACD indicator signal crossovers, entering long positions when the MACD line crosses above the signal line and short positions when it crosses below. It uses configurable fast, slow, and signal periods for the MACD calculation along with lot size and stop loss/take profit parameters. The strategy is a classic momentum-based approach that aims to capture trend continuations following MACD crossover signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MACD指标的金叉和死叉信号进行交易，MACD线上穿信号线时做多，下穿信号线时做空。它使用可配置的快线、慢线和信号线周期参数，以及手数、止损和止盈设置。这是一个经典的动量策略，旨在捕捉MACD交叉信号后的趋势延续。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于经典的MACD动量交叉系统，利用快速EMA与慢速EMA的差值（MACD线）与其信号线的交叉来判断市场动量方向的变化。入场条件为MACD线从下方穿越信号线时开多单（金叉），MACD线从上方穿越信号线时开空单（死叉），这是标准的动量跟踪入场逻辑。出场条件依赖预设的固定止损和止盈水平，也可能在反向交叉信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户通过InpLotSize参数设置每笔交易的手数，没有根据账户余额或波动率进行动态仓位调整。资金管理方面，止损和止盈是硬编码或参数化的固定点数，缺乏基于ATR或其他波动率指标的动态风险控制机制。整体策略逻辑简单直观，但缺乏对假信号和市场震荡行情的过滤机制，容易在横盘市场中频繁产生错误信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the classic MACD momentum crossover system, using the difference between fast and slow EMAs (MACD line) and its signal line crossovers to detect changes in market momentum direction. Entry conditions trigger a long position when the MACD line crosses above the signal line (golden cross) and a short position when it crosses below (death cross), following standard momentum tracking logic. Exit conditions rely on preset fixed stop loss and take profit levels, and may also close positions when an opposing crossover signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user sets the trade volume via the InpLotSize parameter, with no dynamic sizing based on account balance or volatility. Money management employs fixed pip-based stop loss and take profit that are either hardcoded or parameterized, lacking dynamic risk control mechanisms based on ATR or other volatility indicators. The overall strategy logic is simple and intuitive but lacks filtering mechanisms for false signals and ranging market conditions, making it prone to frequent incorrect signals and consecutive losses during sideways markets.
pros: 策略逻辑经典清晰，基于广泛使用的MACD指标，易于理解和验证
参数可配置性强，快线/慢线/信号线周期和风控参数均可调整
入场信号基于动量交叉，在趋势行情中能较好地捕捉中期趋势
代码结构相对简单，便于后续维护和功能扩展
pros_en: Strategy logic is classic and clear, based on the widely-used MACD indicator, easy to understand and verify
High configurability with adjustable fast/slow/signal periods and risk management parameters
Entry signals based on momentum crossovers can capture medium-term trends effectively in trending markets
Relatively simple code structure facilitates future maintenance and feature expansion
cons: 缺乏横盘市场过滤机制，在震荡行情中会产生大量虚假交叉信号
固定手数和固定止损止盈无法适应不同市场波动率环境
没有新K线检查机制，可能每tick都尝试开仓导致重复交易
缺少仓位检查和最大持仓限制，存在过度交易风险
未考虑点差和滑点影响，在低流动性时段交易成本可能过高
cons_en: Lacks ranging market filtering, generating numerous false crossover signals during sideways conditions
Fixed lot size and fixed SL/TP cannot adapt to different market volatility environments
No new bar check mechanism, potentially attempting to open positions on every tick causing duplicate trades
Missing position check and maximum position limits, creating overtrading risk
Does not account for spread and slippage impact, trading costs may be excessive during low liquidity sessions
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器，在横盘市场中抑制虚假信号
加入ATR动态止损止盈和基于账户风险的仓位计算
添加新K线检查和最大持仓限制以防止重复开仓和过度交易
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to suppress false signals during ranging markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit and account-risk-based position sizing
Add new bar check and maximum position limits to prevent duplicate entries and overtrading

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查可能导致每tick重复开仓
固定止损止盈不适应波动率变化，在高波动时段止损可能过小
没有最大持仓限制和仓位检查，存在过度交易风险
横盘市场中MACD频繁交叉会产生连续亏损信号
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause duplicate position opening on every tick
Fixed SL/TP does not adapt to volatility changes, stop loss may be too small during high volatility periods
No maximum position limit or position check creates overtrading risk
Frequent MACD crossovers in ranging markets generate consecutive losing signals
